verify.notes: V8723 Rescan of every rip-relative reference to 0x14604bbf0 in .xtls and .data1 (and absolute pointers in all sections) finds exactly two: the store at 0x1406d6b8f in 0x1406d6360 and the load at 0x14077b3fe in 0x14077a3d0; no other writer. 0x1406d6360 is slot +0x20 of the telemetry subsystem vtable 0x1456420d0 (destructor 0x14081df70 is slot 0): a dependency-resolve init that fetches systems from the service locator and stores the globals only when every lookup is non-null, so the global stays null until it has run. Not shown: when in boot or the front end it is called. fe_tiles.ctx is unique (sigcheck OK hits=1, target 0x14604bbf0). The ctx's own init 0x142428b50 fills +0x228..+0x240 separately, so a non-null ctx does not prove +0x238 is set (the core now checks it).
